newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Maine-Endwell CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Maine-Endwell CSD, N.Y..

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the undersigned President of the Board of Education of Maine- Endwell Central School District, Broome County, New York, at the offices of Willkie Farr &Gallagher, 17th Floor
Conference Room, 900 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10022- 4677, until 12:00 o'clock P.M., Prevailing Time,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $2,200,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated June 15, 1997, with the interest thereon payable on December 15, 1997 and semi- annually thereafter on June 15 and December 15 and maturing June 15 as follows:

THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE THOMSON MUNICIPAL NEWS (FORMERLY KNOWN AS MUNIFACTS WIRE). Each bid, accompanied by a $44,000 good faith check, must be for all of said $2,200,000 bonds. The award will be made based on net interest cost. The purchaser will be furnished will be furnished without cost, the unqualified legal opinion as the validity of the Bonds of Willkie Farr &Gallagher, New York, New York, Bond Counsel. Bidders must refer to the complete Notice of Sale for the terms and conditions of the sale. To obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Official Statement of the School District, please contact Fiscal Advisors and Marketing, Inc., Telephone (315) 699-7912, telecopier: (315) 699-8833. Additional Official Statements may be downloaded from Fiscal Advisors &Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address: http://www.fiscaladvisors.com. Dated: June 3, 1997.
